prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1484; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed first notice of loss for a left-turn collision at an intersection. Insured reports the other vehicle was approaching from the opposite direction and struck the driver side after insured began the turn on a green arrow. Scene photos requested from insured. No injuries reported at the scene.

Entry 2: Claimant's representing attorney's office contacted the desk to confirm they are now counsel of record. Letter of representation received and logged. All further contact with claimant to be routed through counsel. Requested medical authorization forms through the firm.

Entry 3: Claimant reports a shoulder injury following the collision and has been referred for imaging. Counsel provided preliminary medical summary indicating ongoing treatment. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect a bodily injury component pending records. Supervisor notified of possible litigation exposure.

Entry 4: Obtained the police report, which notes the other driver was cited for failure to yield on the opposing approach. Witness statement from a passenger in the insured's vehicle is consistent with the insured's account. Liability position under review; preliminary view leans toward the other driver bearing primary fault.

Entry 5: Received demand package from claimant's counsel including treatment records and billing summary for the shoulder injury. Records forwarded to medical review for evaluation. Requested an independent review of the treatment plan and whether further records are needed before valuation. Follow-up with counsel scheduled once review is complete.
